integrity: The proof is analytic. Standalone finite tests of symbolic/rational identities and numerical asymptotics are reproducibility evidence and not a substitute for infinite-case proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is local at a nominal migration rate, for a single perfectly observed symmetric two-habitat CTMC with mandatory endpoint samples and a fixed number of gaps. The one-short-gap constant and Fisher additivity are known; the fixed-endpoint all-budget limiting gap law and exponential comparison are the proposed new claim. A relevant 2013 GPS paper was not available in full; no historical-priority or independent certification is claimed.
title: A terminal-anchor gap law for two-habitat migration telemetry
